Tessera edges and directional rows are crisp at mobile scale, with no visible compression blocks, halos, banding, smearing, malformed contours, or scaling damage.

asset=1280; vision_mobile_readable=true; artifacts=false; ocr_exact_match=N/A. The supplied 1280-pixel WebP was directly inspected. asset=fallback; vision_mobile_readable=true; artifacts=false; ocr_exact_match=N/A. The supplied JPEG fallback was directly inspected.
